purpose: determine whether Binance currently deploys any active TradFi equity option population that could support a separately frozen long-option plus opposite matching TradFi-perpetual terminal-payoff lower-bound screen

prospective_decision.zero_active_rows: terminalize the current public stock-option deployment premise and stop without option tickers futures metadata books premium index or funding history
prospective_decision.one_or_more_active_rows: retain only the complete active symbol identity population and freeze one separate exact economics contract before any downstream market-data request
downstream_minimum_requirements: source-proved stock-option exercise style settlement time settlement index and contract unit
an exact matching active Binance TradFi perpetual underlying and unit conversion
option executable ask price and displayed quantity
perpetual executable entry book side and quantity
option entry exercise settlement and exit fees
direction-specific adverse funding and expiry exit-basis stress
non-atomic orphan liquidation opportunity tax custody and operational costs
strictly positive worst-state same-unit terminal floor after every cost
prospective_decision.accepted_edge: never from inventory; recurring exact executable after-cost evidence and separate account qualification remain mandatory
prospective_decision.all_outcomes: accepted edge count remains unchanged and no authenticated funded paper or live action is authorized

method.sorted_population_hash: SHA-256 of newline-joined active symbol names in lexical order; the empty population hashes the empty byte string
